aboutpage.name: Name
aboutpage.name_v: Pol Morera de Frutos (professionally, Pol Morera)
aboutpage.what_v: Male UGC creator and video producer
aboutpage.img_alt: Pol Morera, male UGC creator in Spain
story: Before UGC, I was already working in front of a camera and behind social media accounts. While studying Computer Engineering at UPC, I ran the social media of the Barcelona School of Informatics, and for almost two years I hosted and produced more than 50 live streams for La Lanza de Plata. Then came the Rivals D&D broadcasts and GoIT's webinars.

I filmed my first video in 2023 for Decathlon, where I worked as a running specialist: on my phone, with no mic, in my garage at home. I learned the almost one-minute script by heart because cutting never crossed my mind. What I did have was a huge urge to share what I knew about running shoes.

In April 2024 I started doing this full time, while studying Communication at UOC. Today I work like a production company for businesses and agencies: with my team, I handle the whole process, from strategy and script to filming and editing. That's over 1,000 videos for more than 300 brands, such as Just Eat, Revolut, Marvel Snap and Daikin.
One thing hasn't changed since that first video: I still enjoy it every time I step in front of the camera.

how.d: Many brands come back. We've been working with Apple Tree for 31 months, with Dogfy Diet for two years and with Reactiva Online for 15 months.
You get the proposal within 2 working days and most projects are ready in 5–7. If it's urgent, we adapt.
I don't just show how a video looks, but what it achieves: like MasterD's 390 conversions on TikTok Ads or Dogfy Diet's leads, converting at 10–20%.

numbers.l: months with one of my longest-standing clients

career.d: UGC, corporate video and content for social media and ads: strategy, script, filming and editing.
Besides advising customers and training other sales staff, I created the content for the store's account: ideas, script and production.
I hosted weekly webinars and filmed videos for their social media.
I hosted the live competition days and commentated the matches.
More than 50 live streams of around 2 hours, online and in-person events, community and brand collaborations.
Social media and news for the faculty's website.

talks.d: I led a workshop for the Elastic team in Barcelona during the onboarding week for their new hires: a team activity that also supported Fundación Altarriba.
I talked with Luis Crisenti about how to start creating content, the tools available and the impact it has on businesses (in Spanish).

ugcpage.when_title: When does a male UGC creator make sense?
when: When most of your customers are men, or your product is mainly used by men.
When you want the ad to sound like a recommendation from someone like your customer: "I use it and it works for me".
When you want to test a version with a male voice against one with a female voice in your ads, to see which one sells more.
sectors: finance: Revolut, Qonto, Scalable Capital and Bitnovo;
ugcpage.who_text: Usually it's me. If your campaign needs another man of a different age, or a woman, I work with my network of actors and actresses of different ages and profiles. We decide together based on the tone of the campaign and who you're selling to.
